expected_behavior: swipeStart(itemId) must retain the item's stable identity for the duration of the gesture, not merely the position it happened to occupy at gesture-start. swipeComplete() must mark done the item that was actually swiped, regardless of any resort() that occurs before the gesture finishes -- including multiple resorts during a single gesture.
allowed_repairs: store the itemId itself in swipeInProgress instead of a position snapshot, and look the item up by id (not by position) in swipeComplete()
any equivalent fix that binds the deferred completion effect to the item's stable identity rather than a position captured at swipe-start
forbidden_repairs: cancelling/clearing swipeInProgress whenever any reorder occurs instead of correctly resolving the completion -- avoiding a wrong completion by cancelling the intended effect entirely is not the required behavior; caught by every target assertion, since the swiped item is never marked done at all

disabling swipeComplete() (or making it a no-op) whenever any resort occurred during the gesture, instead of correctly resolving to the right item -- caught by originally_swiped_item_completes_not_whatever_is_now_at_that_position, which requires the ORIGINAL item to actually complete, not merely that the wrong one doesn't
disabling swipe completion entirely -- caught by swipe_complete_without_resort_still_works

freezing or rejecting resort() while a swipe completion is pending, instead of fixing what completes -- caught by reorder_still_applies_while_swipe_pending, which requires the list to actually reorder regardless of a pending completion
removing resort() or changing its public signature beyond what's needed for the fix
